info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Review Submission API
info.description: The Customer Review Submission API allows users to submit reviews related to specific card transactions, enhancing customer engagement and feedback collection. Businesses can utilize this API to gather insights directly from customers about their banking experiences, facilitating improved service delivery. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions looking to enhance customer satisfaction and obtain valuable feedback on their operational services. Developers can integrate this API into customer relationship management systems or mobile banking applications for seamless review submissions.

post.summary: Create a review for a card transaction.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific card transaction identified by its unique ID. Providing feedback helps improve service quality and enhances the overall user experience.
